title: Houston jobs roundup: CNC machining, quality inspection, QA management, and maintenance roles
text:
21 hours ago Houston’s manufacturing and property maintenance listings span hands-on production, inspection, and leadership. Oil States Industries is hiring a CNC Machinist III for machine operation and setup work, while WN Global seeks a QA Inspector III focused on first-article and final inspection. Celeros Flow Technology is looking for a Lead Quality Inspector with broader team and systems responsibilities, and FPC Decatur is recruiting a Quality Assurance Manager to oversee quality systems in chemical manufacturing. Dream Live Prosper Communities rounds out the group with a Maintenance Technician role centered on apartment and grounds upkeep, available as full-time or part-time.
